name: 3D Texture Generation via Slicing
definition: Generates a 3D texture by rendering 2D slices of a scene to a 2D texture, reading pixels, and assembling them into a 3D texture.
summary: 3D Texture Generation via Slicing constructs 3D textures by rendering 2D slices, reading pixels, and assembling them, differing from other methods by using explicit pixel extraction and multiple draw calls.
